sections.name: SeismographProps, pct
sections.title: Chart options and percentage helper
sections.what: Describes the chart's inputs, including the dashed estimate that is labelled as an estimate, and includes a helper that turns a probability into a whole percentage.
sections.why: The estimate is labelled so users do not read it as what happened.
sections.watch_out: The default swing threshold is 15 points, so changing it changes how many markers appear.

sections.name: SwingSeismograph
sections.title: The chart
sections.what: Draws the win-probability line over time, a fifty percent midline, a marker for each big swing, and the optional dashed estimate. Adds a caption, a collapsible table of the same numbers, and a text description for screen readers.
sections.why: Gives the same information in a visual, a list and a table, so it is not only visual.
sections.watch_out: Empty input draws only the midline and a No data yet note, which can look like an empty chart rather than a failed load.

summary: Draws a win-probability line over the course of a match, marks big swings, and offers the same numbers as a table.
purpose: Shows how the chance of winning moved during a chase, for the owner or a user to read.
why: Showing swings and a data table makes the chart readable and accessible, not only visual.
how: Scales the points to fit a box, draws a midline at fifty percent, draws the main line, adds marks for swings over the threshold, optionally draws a dashed estimate for the other option, and adds a caption and a collapsible table with a text description.
inputs: A title, a list of time and win-probability points, an optional dashed estimate list, the swing threshold, a time formatter, and width and height.
outputs: A figure containing the chart, a caption, and a data table, with a text description for screen readers.
risks: Empty input shows only the midline and a No data yet note. The dashed line is only an estimate and must not be read as fact.
debug: If the line is missing, check the points list is not empty. If the scale looks wrong, check the time values and whether the shared domain is passed. If swings do not show, check the threshold value.
